latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of error-prone skill.

- Makes AI-generated text sound more human by adding realistic imperfections.
- Supports three imperfection levels (Professional Human, Casual Human, Unhinged) for different contexts.
- Triggers on prompts requesting humanization or imperfections.
- Includes clear rules and examples to maintain meaning and context while varying errors.
